dct_title_s: Improvement plan of Oak Lake Parks, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: An improvement plan for Oak Lake Parks in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The plan is found in the Thirty-fourth Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page 61.
